slopium.enabled.tooltip: Enable Slopium optimizations. Disable for an A/B comparison. Distant Horizons settings remain independent.
slopium.diagnostics.tooltip: Record light queries, skipped updates and intervals between frames. /slopium status shows average FPS, p95/p99 and counters; /slopium reset starts a new capture. Menus and pauses are excluded. Retains the latest 16,384 intervals.
slopium.indexed_lighting.tooltip: Search neighboring cells instead of all sources. Preserves Sodium Dynamic Lights attenuation and radius. Captures source positions after the current frame light update.
slopium.light_cache.tooltip: Reuse identical light queries within one source snapshot, particularly for block damage overlays. Requires spatial light lookup.
slopium.create_light.tooltip: Allow Create Dynamic Light sources. Supports the active 2.0.1 or 2.3.1-sodium-sable version. Disabling also removes this addon’s Sable light; other sources are unaffected.
slopium.sable_light.tooltip: Allow Sable sub-level lights from 2.3.1-sodium-sable. Requires Create contraption lights.
slopium.cull_breaking: Skip breaking cracks outside the view
slopium.cull_breaking.tooltip: Skip damage overlay geometry outside the camera frustum, with a model-bound margin. Sable plots and virtual worlds are excluded.
slopium.hidden_ticks.tooltip: Experimental. Throttle selected Create types confirmed hidden by EntityCulling. Excludes servers, belts, trains and Sable plots. May affect sound and animation. Disabled by default.
slopium.tick_interval: Behind obstacles: one tick out of N
slopium.tick_interval.tooltip: For obstacle and EntityCulling policies: run one client tick out of N after the grace period. 4 means about 5 updates/s instead of 20. Server rate is unchanged.
slopium.protected_distance.tooltip: Only for EntityCulling. Wall culling has a fixed 4-block protection zone; distance mode has its own radius.
slopium.hidden_grace.tooltip: How many client ticks the mechanism must remain hidden before reducing updates. Used for obstacle and EntityCulling policies. Packets and restored visibility reset this delay.
slopium.disable_be_render.tooltip: Hides world block entity renderers. Static block meshes remain. Ticks and packets continue. Flywheel is controlled separately.
slopium.disable_flywheel_render.tooltip: Skips Flywheel instancing and indirect draws, including moving Create parts. Visual updates and resource maintenance continue. Fallback uses normal renderers.
slopium.disable_particles.tooltip: Skips standard ParticleEngine additions and rendering. Existing particles keep aging. Custom particle systems may remain.
slopium.disable_ambient.tooltip: Skips client ambient block/fluid animateTick effects, including particles and some sounds. Server random ticks and block state updates are unchanged.
slopium.freeze_create_ticks.tooltip: Diagnostic only: freezes initialized Create SmartBlockEntity client ticks, including visible blocks. Animations, indicators and client interactions can malfunction. Packets and server ticks continue. Virtual worlds and Sable-protected blocks are excluded. Disable after measurement; reconnect if necessary.
slopium.item_lod.tooltip: Draws one model copy for distant dropped stacks. ItemStack, count and pickup are unchanged. Nearby stacks retain normal visuals.
slopium.item_lod_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera. One model beyond this radius. Effective radius is capped at the current chunk render distance.
slopium.item_range.tooltip: Radical visual cut: hides distant dropped items. Entities, ticks and pickup remain unchanged.
slopium.item_render_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera to model bounds. Zero hides items outside the camera. Capped at chunk render distance.
slopium.be_range.tooltip: Cuts distant special models before Sodium preparation. Static blocks and Flywheel remain. Sable-protected positions are excluded. Uses renderer bounds for large models.
slopium.be_render_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera to model bounds, capped at chunk render distance. May hide indicators and machine contents.
slopium.pause_xaero_benchmark.tooltip: Skips TextureUploader benchmark waits only. Uploads, queues and buffer recycling continue. Xaero uses default estimates until calibration finishes; map refresh may slow down. Disabling resumes measurement.
slopium.disable_shadows.tooltip: Skips vanilla entity shadow projections. Entities and lighting remain; custom shader shadows are unaffected.
slopium.flywheel_distance: Update distant Flywheel animations less often
slopium.flywheel_distance.tooltip: Experimental: uses Flywheel DistanceUpdateLimiter. Distant animations update less frequently. Queues, world ticks and resource maintenance continue. Only affects visuals using this API; not universal culling.
slopium.flywheel_distance_radius.tooltip: Distance in blocks as supplied by the visual to Flywheel. Original Flywheel policy applies inside.
slopium.flywheel_interval.tooltip: Update distant visuals once every N frames. Higher values make animations less smooth.
slopium.item_impostors: Replace distant items with flat sprites
slopium.item_impostors.tooltip: Replaces the model with one camera-facing quad using its particle texture. Blocks become flat material samples; rotation and depth are lost. Named, foil and custom-rendered items are excluded. Counts and pickup are unchanged.
slopium.item_impostor_distance.tooltip: Blocks from camera. Full models inside, flat sprites outside. Capped at chunk render distance.
slopium.create_visuals: Throttle distant press, mixer and funnel frames
slopium.create_visuals.tooltip: Only Flywheel press, mixer and funnel visuals. Updates distant transforms less frequently. Client ticks, packets, lighting and visual deletion continue. Sable-protected and virtual worlds are excluded. Not universal culling.
slopium.create_visual_distance.tooltip: Blocks to machine center, plus a 4-block margin for extending parts. Updates every frame inside.
slopium.create_visual_interval.tooltip: Updates distant model transforms once every N frames. Motion becomes stepped; approaching refreshes immediately.
slopium.particle_budget.tooltip: Caps new standard ParticleEngine particles per client tick. Excess effects are dropped; existing particles age normally. Custom systems may bypass this cap.
slopium.particles_per_tick.tooltip: Global standard particle cap. Zero rejects new particles. Does not distinguish decorative from informative effects.
slopium.texture_interpolation.tooltip: Skips intermediate blending for standard animated textures. Animation clocks and keyframes continue. Motion becomes stepped; inventory appearance also changes.
slopium.factory_connections.tooltip: Hides distant connection lines. Panels and server logistics remain intact. Keeps lines near either endpoint and the targeted panel. This reduces visual detail.
slopium.factory_bulbs.tooltip: Hides distant indicator bulbs and glow. Panel base and items remain; server state is unchanged.
slopium.particle_light_cache.tooltip: Reuses base particle lighting within a game tick and block position. Preserves particle count. Lighting refreshes up to 20 times/s; changes can lag one tick. Custom formulas outside the base method are unaffected.
slopium.particle_range.tooltip: Skips distant standard-engine particle draws, preserving simulation and lifetime. Does not limit emissions. Uses render bounds for large effects.
slopium.distance_create_ticks.tooltip: Experimental for all Create SmartBlockEntity instances, including visible ones. Runs one tick in N at distance; animations, sounds and client indicators may slow down. Server ticks are untouched. Near camera, in menus, after packets and on Sable uses normal cadence. Replaces hidden-tick mode; full freeze takes priority.
slopium.create_tick_interval: Beyond radius: one tick out of N
slopium.create_tick_interval.tooltip: 2–10. Skipped time is not replayed. Higher values slow distant client effects more.
slopium.factory_connection_distance.tool: Distance to panel centre plus 2 blocks, capped by chunk distance. Only used in Nearby only mode. Targeted panels remain visible.
slopium.factory_bulb_distance.tooltip: 0–512 blocks from panel center to camera, capped by chunk render distance. No previous +2 block margin. Bulbs and glow are hidden outside; state ticks continue.
slopium.particle_render_distance.tooltip: Distance to effect bounds, capped by chunk render distance. Only used when distant particle hiding is enabled. Motion and lifetime continue.
slopium.create_tick_distance.tooltip: Distance to mechanism centre plus 4 blocks. Only used in Beyond radius mode. Nearby/interacting machines stay at full rate.
slopium.occlude_particles.tooltip: Skips particle rendering when 9 bounds samples are blocked by the selected occluders. Simulation continues. Budgeted and cached; unknown means visible. Narrow openings may be misclassified.
slopium.occlude_create_rendering.tooltip: Culls normal Create SmartBlockEntity rendering using renderer bounds and selected occluders. Flywheel is separate. Large/infinite bounds and Sable are excluded.
slopium.occlude_flywheel.tooltip: Hides audited SingleAxisRotatingVisual, ShaftVisual, PressVisual, MixerVisual and FunnelVisual instances through Flywheel API. Restores on visibility or disabling. Not all machines or contraptions are covered.
slopium.occlude_create_animations.toolti: Skips hidden press, mixer and funnel beginFrame transforms. Geometry is controlled separately by Flywheel occlusion. Workers only read visibility results; no world traversal.
slopium.occlude_create_ticks.tooltip: Runs one tick in N behind walls after grace; uses interval/grace from Visibility page. Normal ticks within 4 blocks of player and during interaction. May slow client effects; server unchanged. Takes priority over distance mode, not full freeze.
slopium.hide_factory_connections.tooltip: No radius: removes all FactoryPanelRenderer connection lines, including nearby. Panels, items and server links remain. Diagnostic detail reduction to isolate line rendering cost.
slopium.factory_items.tooltip: Full item rendering inside the radius; skip it outside. Only FactoryPanel, not other Create filters. Targeted panels, menus and Sable retain normal rendering. Server items and filters are unchanged.
slopium.factory_item_distance.tooltip: 0–512 blocks from panel center to camera, capped by chunk render distance. Items beyond the radius are hidden, not replaced with sprites.
slopium.particle_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.create_render_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.flywheel_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.animation_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.tick_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: blocks marked by the game as opaque occluders. Any blocks: also glass, panes, doors, bars, plants and fluids when their shape intersects the ray. Empty parts remain open. Independent per feature; does not enable culling by itself.
slopium.group.create_visibility: Model culling: regular rendering and Flywheel
slopium.group.test_warning: Full overrides take priority over normal settings
slopium.particle_visibility.tooltip: Off: no wall culling. Opaque blocks: hide behind solid walls. Any blocks: also hide behind glass and other block shapes. Traces to the interpolated particle centre, not the expanded frustum box. Whole particles may pop at obstacle edges. Ticks continue. A separate bounded queue defers excess checks; external particle systems are not covered. Hide all particles disables standard particle creation and rendering.
slopium.create_visibility.tooltip: Behind obstacles: hide special models using a ray to the mechanism block centre, including adjacent glass. Hide all: disable ordinary Create BlockEntityRenderers regardless of visibility. Chunk geometry stays; Flywheel is separate. Partly visible models may disappear near window edges. Close menus to test; the targeted block is protected.
slopium.flywheel_visibility.tooltip: Behind obstacles: hide audited shafts, large and small cogs, encased cogs, gearboxes, fans, split shafts, presses, mixers and funnels using the block centre ray. Adjacent glass counts. Not all visuals are covered; Sable is protected. Hide all: suppress ALL Flywheel rendering, including other mods. Chunk geometry stays. Animations are separate.
slopium.animation_visibility.tooltip: Off: normal animations. Behind obstacles: pause supported models behind the selected blocks. Pause everywhere: ignore visibility. Covers rotating shafts, cogs, gearboxes, fans and split shafts, plus frame updates of presses, mixers and funnels. Requires an active Flywheel backend. Models remain visible; mechanism speed and client ticks are unchanged. Other animations are not covered.
slopium.create_tick_mode.tooltip: Choose one policy: off, behind obstacles, beyond radius, EntityCulling, or full freeze. Freeze all skips supported client ticks even for visible mechanisms. Effects, sounds and indicators can freeze; server simulation continues. Throttling modes retain proximity and interaction guards. Inapplicable parameters are disabled.
slopium.factory_connection_mode.tooltip: All: normal lines. Nearby only: limit by radius with endpoint/target protection. None: hide all lines. Server logistics are unchanged.
slopium.block_models.tooltip: Show all: normal block entity rendering. Within radius: skip models beyond the radius. Hide all: disable all ordinary BlockEntityRenderers. Chunk geometry and Flywheel remain separate. Server mechanisms keep running.
slopium.hint.block_radius: Available only with Special block models → Within radius.
